editorial_policy.sensationalism: engaging presentation only; no exaggerated or unverified claims

stories.headline: Roadways bus fire; 55 passengers escaped
stories.claim: A Bareilly-depot AC bus travelling Delhi to Bareilly caught fire near Dalpatpur overbridge on 4 Nov evening; all 55 passengers escaped. Tyre burst is preliminary explanation only.

stories.headline: Pre-Diwali FSDA sweet-shop inspections
stories.claim: Statewide inspection/seizure/licence data plus local hygiene violations and 220kg sweets destroyed after flies were found.

stories.headline: ₹99,000 reported cyber fraud during order cancellation
stories.claim: A local complainant reports losing about ₹99,000 after following a purported customer-care cancellation process; no evidence of platform breach or involvement.

stories.headline: Traders expect about ₹100 crore Dhanteras sales
stories.claim: Local traders forecast about ₹100 crore district-wide trade; not audited actual sales.

stories.headline: Food inflation and weak winter planting
stories.claim: September food inflation 7.74%; weak soil moisture may pressure winter sowing and food supplies.

stories.headline: Murasu cyclone recovery in Andhra Pradesh
stories.claim: Latest confirmed preliminary figures located by 05:59 IST: at least two deaths, crops damaged across 52,459 hectares, 312 houses affected, preliminary loss about ₹344 crore and 12,230 people in relief centres; IMD said the storm had weakened to a depression by 4 Nov morning.

stories.headline: Gold demand down 29% in Q3 as high prices weigh on festive buyers
stories.claim: Q3 demand down 29% year-on-year; full-year demand outlook 625–675 tonnes.

stories.headline: ₹14,500 crore grid-scale energy storage scheme
stories.claim: 92 GWh planned capacity across pumped hydro, battery and emerging technologies.

stories.headline: ₹2,814 crore lithium/nickel processing support
stories.claim: Four plants planned, with 30% eligible capital subsidy.

stories.headline: CERT-In names AI-assisted CRAFTY FALCON in attacks on financial firms
stories.claim: Warning is directed to financial institutions; do not claim all personal bank accounts are affected.

stories.headline: India beat New Zealand in first ODI
stories.claim: India won by five wickets under DLS; Kohli scored 74.

stories.headline: Fast Track Special Courts scheme extended to 2031
stories.claim: Scheme provides for up to 850 courts from 779 functional; not 850 new courts already operating.

stories.headline: Illegal firecracker unit found inside house in densely populated Nagphani area
stories.claim: Police say 83 kg 250 g gunpowder, 27 sacks of fireworks and forged branded packaging were recovered from a house in Gudiya Bagh; two brothers were arrested and an FIR registered.

stories.headline: Food-safety officer explains a limited iodine test for starch in paneer
stories.claim: The prescribed boil-cool-iodine method turns blue when starch is present. It does not detect every kind of adulteration and cannot certify paneer as safe or fake on its own.

stories.place: Delhi-NCR, including Ghaziabad and Gautam Buddha Nagar
stories.headline: CAQM pollution curbs start today: construction restrictions and up-to-50% office attendance
stories.claim: From 5 to 20 Nov, dust-generating demolition/outdoor construction is restricted across NCR with listed exceptions. Up to 50% physical attendance applies to state government and private offices in Delhi and Gurugram, Faridabad, Sonipat, Ghaziabad and Gautam Buddha Nagar; remaining staff work from home. Gurugram AQI was reported at 322 on Wednesday 4 Nov, not as a 5 Nov live reading.

stories.headline: Supreme Court sends two-child disqualification rule to larger bench
stories.claim: The Court questioned the contemporary basis of laws disqualifying people with more than two children from local-body elections and referred a challenge to a larger bench. The case concerns Maharashtra; no blanket nationwide or UP rule has been struck down.

stories.headline: FSSAI and energy-drink makers face another hearing over the label on high-caffeine drinks
stories.claim: FSSAI says the label 'energy drink' is misleading and that no formal category exists; PepsiCo and Monster contest the process. Existing labelled stock may be sold under the interim arrangement, but new stock cannot use the descriptor. This is not a finding that products are poisonous or a blanket ban.

stories.headline: Ramayana: Part 1 opens in theatres today after large advance bookings
stories.claim: The film releases on 5 Nov. An Indian Express live update reported ₹110.06 crore in advance bookings across six show dates as of 18:15 on 4 Nov, or ₹88.11 crore excluding blocked seats; this is pre-sales, not realised box-office revenue. The producer said Part 2 is pushed to 2028.

verification_notes: Active lineup for 07:00 IST contains five Western UP items plus local weather, with exactly 210 of 600 seconds (35%).
No recruitment, government-job or exam/admit-card story is in the active lineup.
W1 bus-fire cause is attributed to the Chief Fire Officer in local reports; no final engineering or forensic report was located.
W2 FSDA inspections/seizures/licence suspensions are not equivalent to final laboratory proof of adulteration.
W3 Sambhal ₹99,000 cyber-fraud item is a complainant's reported experience; it does not establish a Flipkart platform breach or money recovery.
W5 illegal firecracker-unit reports appear based on the same police briefing; attribute the seizure and arrests to police, not independent eyewitness confirmation.
W6 iodine test only screens for starch in the prescribed sample procedure; it does not detect all adulterants and is not a complete authenticity or safety test.
N1 CPI figures refer to September 2026; weak soil moisture is an outlook risk, not a guaranteed local price increase.
N3 Q3 gold demand is WGC data; the full-year 625–675 tonne range is a forecast. Dhanteras is 6 November 2026.
N6 CRAFTY FALCON is an active CERT-In advisory about BFSI infrastructure and payment/disbursement APIs; do not imply all personal bank accounts are compromised.
N9 CAQM order is preventive and valid 5–20 November. Construction restrictions cover NCR with exceptions; the 50% office-attendance clause has a narrower list of five districts plus Delhi.
N9 Gurugram AQI 322 was reported for Wednesday 4 November, not as a live 5 November reading.
N10 Supreme Court referred the two-child norm issue to a larger bench; it did not finally strike down all such laws or automatically change UP law.
N11 Delhi High Court's 5 November energy-drink label hearing had no outcome by the 07:00 IST research cut-off; no claim of a ban or poisoning finding.
N12 Ramayana advance-booking gross includes cinema-blocked seats; it is not realised ticket revenue or an opening-day collection.
IMD West UP warning page issued 5 November shows no warning 5–11 November. Moradabad and Bareilly city pages are dated 4 November; Sambhal city temperature was not found.
IMD subdivision warning pages do not display exact issue time. Do not invent one.
Bijnor Ayurvedic-store fire, Bijnor woman death after tea (post-mortem inconclusive), and single-source sugarcane-cart accident remain reserve/HOLD, not in the active lineup.
